symptom.zh-Hans: 启动器窗口标题栏正常但内容整片白屏。
symptom.en: The launcher window draws its title bar but the content area stays white.

fix.zh-Hans: 启动器的 CEF GPU 进程把画面呈现到另一个进程拥有的子窗口里，需要引擎支持跨进程子窗口（Highball 0007）并打开 DXMT 的 DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN。本档案已自动设置，无需手动操作。
fix.en: The launcher's CEF GPU process presents into a child window owned by another process; that needs the engine's cross-process child swapchains plus DXMT's opt-in. This profile sets it automatically.
